description: This file defines the interface 'FieldStorageConfigInterface' for Drupal's field storage configuration, including method signatures for managing field storage properties.

methods.name: getTypeProvider
methods.description: Returns the name of the module providing the field type.

methods.name: getBundles
methods.description: Returns an array of bundle names where the field storage has fields.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Checks if the field storage can be deleted.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Returns whether the field storage is locked.

methods.name: setLocked
methods.description: Sets the locked flag for the field storage.

methods.name: setCardinality
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of items allowed for the field.

methods.name: setSetting
methods.description: Sets a specific setting value by name.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Sets multiple storage settings at once.

methods.name: setTranslatable
methods.description: Sets whether the field is translatable.
